answer: Require a slow cedar bond: before an agent can earn, it locks a deposit and builds one unbroken record of useful work over many epochs. Trust rises gradually, so a brand-new identity carries no weight at the zenith of the ranking. If the same bond is ever claimed by two names, both lose the deposit at once. Water shaping karst shows the principle: steady honest flow carves a real path, while a sybil burst must pay a fresh deposit and wait through the same slow season for every single fake.
